name: TC-03-master-data-site
description: TC-03.1: Create Sites linked to Organization

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Site List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Site. Sites represent physical locations within an organization. Each site can have multiple departments.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Create Site
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a new site. Link the site to the organization created in the previous step.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Fill Site Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Site A" into the Site Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Site Saved
doc_metadata.caption: The site is created with an auto-generated ID and linked to the organization. Repeat this process to create additional sites.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Site Detail View
doc_metadata.caption: The site record shows the name, organization link, and any child departments. Each site serves as a scope boundary for role-based access control.
